documents.title: Options
documents.text: manifest : an application manifest as json buildpack : a buildpack url (optional) env : a hash of environment variables to use during build

documents.title: Example
documents.text: $ curl -v -X POST https://anvil.herokuapp.com/manifest \ -d "manifest=$(cat manifest.json)" \ -d "buildpack=https%3A%2F%2Fbuildkit.herokuapp.com%2Fbuildkit%2Fdefault.tgz" \ -d "env={'FOO':'bar'}" Connected to anvil.herokuapp.com (107.20.215.233) port 443 ( 0) POST /manifest/build HTTP/1.1 < HTTP/1.1 100 Continue < HTTP/1.1 200 OK < Content-Type: text/plain < Transfer-Encoding: chunked < X-Slug-Url: http://localhost:5000/slugs/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.tgz < Connection: keep-alive < Launching build process... done Recreating app from manifest... done Fetching buildpack... done Detecting buildpack... done, Buildkit+Ruby Compiling app... ...
